name: premiere-night
vibe: A cinema premiere on a dark house — near-black warm walls, chasing marquee bulbs, sweeping spotlight cones, film-strip montages, grain and vignette. Caprasimo titles flip up letter by letter in 3D like a marquee being set, the key word shimmers gold, and stats roll like odometers under the box-office report. Roll out the terracotta carpet — for launches that deserve a red carpet, premieres, trailers, showcases and one-night-only announcements.
